`install-private.raw.b64` is a base64-encoded SquashFS image generated by
`mksquashfs`. Text encoding keeps the fixture compatible with repository diff
review tooling. Tests decode the committed image, so they do not require a local
`mksquashfs` installation or round-trip through the reader being tested.

The image contains two regular files:

`usr/lib/extension-release.d/extension-release.wendyos-hello`:

```text
ID=wendyos
SYSEXT_LEVEL=1
ARCHITECTURE=arm64
WENDYOS_KERNEL=6.6.0-test
```

`usr/lib/wendyos-driver-payloads/wendyos-hello/modules-load.conf`:

```text
wendyos_hello
```

To regenerate, place these files (including final newlines) under `fixture/`,
then run on Linux:

```sh
mksquashfs fixture install-private.raw -noappend -all-root -comp gzip -processors 1 -mkfs-time 0 -all-time 0
base64 install-private.raw > install-private.raw.b64
```

The image has no executable code or kernel modules.
